task.summary: Default task

Add bounce impact speed handling and idle animations for pets
- Added `impact_speed` parameter to `_on_energetic_bounce` to apply throw damage only at high speeds. - Introduced idle bouncing animation for hungry pets. - Adjusted idle and DVD modes to handle animations dynamically.

Increase impact speed threshold for damage calculation
- Updated `DAMAGE_SPEED_THRESHOLD` in `Klippy.gd` from 400.0 to 800.0.

Add developer tools dialog and state system refactor
- Introduced `DevToolsDialog` to allow manual adjustment of pet stats with UI controls. - Added `state` property and `State` enum to replace `dragging` boolean in `PetBody`. - Refactored physics and input handling to accommodate state transitions (`IDLE`, `DRAGGING`, `THROWN`). - Updated `SettingsPanel` and context menu to toggle developer tools visibility. - Implemented debug methods in `Stats.gd` for direct stat modification.

Update idle bounce mechanics and health regeneration logic
- Refactored idle bounce behavior for hungry pets with configurable burst intervals and cycles. - Added stricter type annotation for health regeneration in `Stats.gd`.

Add bounce trigger button and adjust mood/health mechanics
- Added `bounce_triggered` signal and UI button to manually trigger idle bounce behavior in `DevToolsDialog`. - Updated mood/health rates in `Stats.gd` for improved progression balance. - Refined idle bounce logic to integrate manual triggers and reset behavior dynamically.

Refine hungry bounce logic with envelope scaling
- Added `_bounce_envelope` function to scale bounce amplitude dynamically across cycles. - Introduced `HUNGRY_BOUNCE_ENVELOPE_MIN_SCALE` constant for

Improved bouncing
- Added `_bounce_envelope` function to scale bounce amplitude dynamically across cycles. - Introduced `HUNGRY_BOUNCE_ENVELOPE_MIN_SCALE` constant for

Add play tracking and mood boost mechanics
- Introduced `apply_play_boost` method in `Stats.gd` to adjust mood based on play activity. - Added play tracking logic using distance thresholds in `Klippy.gd`. - Integrated health and mood conditions to trigger the play mood boost.

Adjust play mood boost scaling
- Reduced `PLAY_MOOD_BOOST` constant in `Klippy.gd` from 3.0 to 1.5 for better balancing.
Limit FPS to 30 and adjust physics tick rate for performance optimization

Add VSync toggle and FPS selection to settings panel
- Introduced `vsync_toggled` and `fps_selected` signals in `SettingsPanel`. - Added VSync checkbox and FPS selection dropdown to the settings UI. - Integrated new settings with `Klippy.gd` to apply changes dynamically using `_apply_display_settings`. - Extended save/load system to persist VSync and FPS settings.
Add initial README with project overview, requirements, features, and export instructions
Update `.idea/workspace.xml` with task tracking and new edit completion features

Add drag spin mechanics and improve rotation recovery logic
- Introduced `drag_spin_target` with mouse wheel adjustment for spin control during dragging. - Enhanced sprite rotation recovery to seamlessly align with `drag_spin_target`. - Refactored input handling in `PetBody.gd` to incorporate new spin mechanics.

Refactor food spawning and consumption logic to reduce memory
- Introduced `consumed` signal in `FoodBody` to handle food item lifecycle. - Added object pooling for efficient reuse of food windows. - Reduced maximum food items to 8 for better performance and management. - Modularized UI logic for settings, status, and confirmation dialogs.

Refactor food mechanics and update project structure
- Introduced `active_food_items` and `food_window_pool` arrays for efficient food management. - Added constants (`FOOD_WINDOW_SIZE`, `FOOD_MASS`, `MAX_FOOD_ITEMS`) in `Klippy.gd`. - Adjusted `.idea/workspace.xml` and `project.godot` for updated configurations and directory

Refactor food mechanics and update project structure
- Introduced `active_food_items` and `food_window_pool` arrays for efficient food management. - Added constants (`FOOD_WINDOW_SIZE`, `FOOD_MASS`, `MAX_FOOD_ITEMS`) in `Klippy.gd`. - Adjusted `.idea/workspace.xml structure. - Moved `FoodBagBody.gd` and related files to `features/food` for modularity.
Fixed my bad merge.
Prevent collision logic execution when window is not visible

Refactor food bag system with art assets and collision improvements
- Replaced procedural bag rendering with preloaded textures for visual consistency. - Introduced `KlippyFoodBag.png` and `KlippyFoodBagBack.png` as assets for bag visuals. - Updated bag implementation to use `interior_polygon` for dynamic containment checks. - Enhanced collision logic to account for wall outlines and bag interior using traced polygons. - Redesigned food spawning offsets and state flow for better alignment with visuals. - Removed obsolete procedural graphics methods for bag rendering from `FoodBagBody.gd`.

Add `_can_rest` logic to improve idle state handling and update food collision mechanics
- Introduced `_can_rest` to prevent bag-contained objects from prematurely entering idle state. - Enhanced food collision resolution for better interaction between fast-moving objects and bag walls. - Updated `FoodBody` to track all instances for collision checks. - Adjusted `FoodBagBody` to carry food during movement and resolve wall collisions more accurately. - Made windows unfocusable for consistency across components.

Improve food spawning offsets and update bag collision handling
- Improved food spawning jitter for better spread and collision resolution. - Enhanced bag wall collision logic to retain food inside when the bag is invisible. - Adjusted rendering order to ensure food remains visible over bag visuals.

Add `FoodPortal` for spawning visual effects
- Introduced `FoodPortal` with animated opening/closing and vortex visuals for summoning food. - Updated `FoodBagBody.gd` to adjust `WINDOW_MARGIN` for dynamic alignment. - Modified `Klippy.gd` to use `FoodPortal` for spawning food at the portal's position.
Prevent feeding logic from executing when the window is not visible.

Add pupil tracking mechanics and art assets for Klippy
- Introduced left and right pupil tracking based on mouse position. - Added new art assets for Klippy's body, details, and facial components. - Updated `Klippy.tscn` to integrate new textures and structured nodes for facial features. - Implemented `_update_pupils` logic to dynamically follow the cursor while maintaining bounds.

Scale pupil activation radius with size and implement dynamic relaxation behavior.
- Added `PUPIL_ACTIVATION_RADIUS_SCALE` to adjust activation radius proportionally to Klippy's size. - Updated `_update_pupils` to allow pupils to relax to their rest position when the cursor moves outside the activation radius.

Add `FoodCatalog` and refactor food system for modularity
- Introduced `FoodCatalog` and `FoodDef` for centralized food definitions, enabling easier addition of new food types. - Updated `Klippy.gd` and related files to support dynamic food spawning using `FoodCatalog`. - Replaced hardcoded food types and textures with catalog-driven definitions. - Improved food spawning, saving, and loading processes to handle multiple food types.

Add `CosmeticCatalog` and refactor Klippy's cosmetic system
- Introduced `CosmeticCatalog` and `CosmeticSetDef` for centralized management of cosmetic presets, enabling streamlined addition of new looks. - Updated `Klippy.gd` with dynamic cosmetic application logic and wardrobe management. - Added new art assets for "Default" and "Clean Marble" cosmetic sets. - Implemented `WardrobeBody` for GUI-based cosmetic selection. - Removed obsolete texture files and references for unused assets.

Add "Clean Marble" pupil assets for Klippy
- Added `KlippyLeftPupil.png` and `KlippyRightPupil.png` textures for the "Clean Marble" cosmetic set. - Included `.import` metadata for texture compression and processing.

Add `can_rotate` property to control spin behavior for objects
- Introduced `can_rotate` to allow or prevent sprite rotation based on object type. - Updated `PetBody.gd` to respect `can_rotate` during drag, spin, and air interactions for more realistic behavior. - Disabled rotation for `WardrobeBody` to reflect its upright, non-rolling nature.

Split `CosmeticCatalog` into isolated part catalogs for better modularity
- Replaced `CosmeticCatalog` and `CosmeticSetDef` with separate catalogs for body, expressions, eyes, and pupils. - Updated `Klippy.gd` to apply individual cosmetic parts instead of presets. - Introduced `WardrobeDialog` and `CosmeticPickerDialog` for granular cosmetic selection via dedicated UI. - Simplified asset management and enabled scalable addition of new cosmetic options. - Removed obsolete `CosmeticCatalog` structure and associated files.

Add `close_all` method to handle closing related windows in `WardrobeDialog`
- Implemented `close_all` in `WardrobeDialog` to hide both the main window and the picker grid. - Updated `Klippy.gd` to invoke `close_all` when toggling the wardrobe window visibility. - Corrected `close_requested` signal connection to use `close_all` for consistent behavior.

Refactor UI setup for `WardrobeDialog` and `CosmeticPickerDialog` using `RockyTheme.setup_window`
- Simplified window initialization with `RockyTheme.setup_window` for consistent theming and layout. - Updated `WardrobeDialog` to disconnect `hide` and use `close_all` for proper sub-window handling. - Replaced custom title handling in `CosmeticPickerDialog` with `_category_label` for dynamic updates.

Add leveling system and level-based cosmetic unlocks for Klippy
- Introduced `PetLevel` class to track XP and determine Klippy's level. - Added `LevelUnlocks` as a central reference for level-based feature gating. - Updated cosmetics to include `required_level` property for unlockable items. - Integrated leveling mechanics into interactions, play rewards, and save/load functionality. - Enhanced `WardrobeDialog` and other UI components to filter cosmetics based on Klippy's current level.

Add jelly food type with buff mechanics and spawn logic
- Introduced "Jelly" to the `FoodCatalog` with unique properties including bounce damping override, damage immunity, and a timed buff duration. - Updated `PetBody.gd` to use instance-specific bounce damping. - Implemented food buff system in `Klippy.gd` with support for timed effects and reversion upon expiration. - Added rare Jelly spawning with level-based unlock and randomness via `_roll_summon_food_type`.

Enable draggable header for borderless windows in `RockyTheme`
- Added input handling to the header for dragging the window using left mouse button. - Set `mouse_filter` on header elements to pass through events properly.
Increase Jelly spawn chance from 2% to 5% for improved availability

Add bounce rewards for Jelly food type
- Introduced `bounce_xp_reward` and `bounce_mood_reward` properties to `FoodDef`. - Updated `Klippy.gd` to grant XP and mood boosts on bounces during Jelly buff duration. - Reset rewards on buff expiration for proper state management.
Fix ID constants in `Klippy.gd` to ensure correct value assignments

Add hat customization for Klippy with crown cosmetic unlockable at level 50
- Introduced `HatsCatalog` to manage hat definitions, textures, and unlock levels. - Updated `Klippy.gd` to support hat selection, persistence, and rendering. - Enhanced `WardrobeDialog` to include hat selection and appropriate level gating. - Added a crown hat asset and unlocked it at level 50 via `LevelUnlocks`.
Update import settings for KlippyCrown hat asset

Add passive XP gain for Klippy with ecstatic mood boost
- Introduced smooth XP trickle based on mood status via `apply_passive_gain` in `PetLevel.gd`. - Updated `_process` in `Klippy.gd` to enable passive XP growth when Klippy is alive.

Add XP progress bar to Status Dialog and theme updates for ProgressBar styling
- Added `xp_bar` to `StatusDialog` to visually represent XP progress. - Updated `RockyTheme` to define consistent styling for `ProgressBar` elements.

Add XP Gem food type with instant XP reward
- Introduced "XP Gem" to `FoodCatalog` with unique properties, including no hunger benefit and a large instant XP grant. - Updated `FoodDef` to support `xp_reward` for one-time XP bonuses. - Added rare XP Gem spawn logic to `_roll_summon_food_type` in `Klippy.gd`.

Improve collision resolution with friction and slop adjustments
- Added `PENETRATION_SLOP` to reduce jitter in resting body collisions by ignoring minimal overlaps. - Enhanced collision handling to include friction, preventing indefinite sliding on contact surfaces. - Updated restitution logic to cancel minor velocities below `REST_SPEED`, reducing visual vibration. - Refactored method signatures to include `delta` for time-dependent calculations.

Add "Obsidian" cosmetics set for Klippy
- Introduced the "Obsidian" theme for bodies, eyes, pupils, and expressions, with new texture assets. - Updated `BodyCatalog`, `EyesCatalog`, `PupilsCatalog`, and `ExpressionCatalog` to include "Obsidian" entries.

Add sleep mechanics for Klippy
- Introduced the ability for Klippy to sleep, with reduced food decay and enhanced health regeneration during sleep. - Added shake-to-wake and throw-to-wake interactions to exit sleep state. - Updated `Stats.gd` to track sleep state and added relevant signals for transitions. - Enhanced context menu with a toggle for sleep and dynamic status changes. - Integrated random wake-up dialogues for a more interactive experience.

Introduce Klippy Points as new in-game currency
- Added `KlippyPoints` class for managing currency, including earning, spending, and debugging adjustments. - Integrated currency details into `StatusDialog` for live updates and display. - Updated save/load logic in `Klippy.gd` to persist Klippy Points. -

Introduce Klippy Points as new in-game currency
- Added `KlippyPoints` class for managing currency, including earning, spending, and debugging adjustments. - Integrated currency details into `StatusDialog` for live updates and display. - Updated save/load logic in `Klippy.gd` to persist Klippy Points. Enhanced `DevToolsDialog` with debugging controls for Klippy Points. - Adjusted food spawning and feeding logic to use `PetBody` as the central anchor for positional calculations. - Introduced `_content_inset` support across relevant bodies for better interaction bounds.
